subject: GLX Pilot Permit Parking Expansion
overview: The Medford Traffic Commission discussed expanding the pilot residential permit parking opt-out program surrounding Green Line Extension stations and acted on numerous resident parking and traffic requests. The commission voted to table the GLX permit parking expansion proposal while approving several handicap space applications, parking variances, and corner restrictions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the August special meeting.

items.title: GLX Pilot Residential Permit Parking Expansion (Item 2022-49)
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to proactively expand the pilot residential permit parking opt-out program across public streets within roughly a half-mile radius of Green Line Extension stations.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign - 37 7th Street (Item 2022-41)
items.summary: Approved a request for a handicap parking sign at 37 7th Street.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign - 9 Wareham Street (Item 2022-42)
items.summary: Approved a request for a handicap parking sign at 9 Wareham Street.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance - 60 Elm Street (Item 2022-43)
items.summary: Tabled a request for a permit parking variance on Brackett Street for 60 Elm Street until the petitioner can attend.

items.title: 15-Minute Parking Sign - 433 Salem Street (Item 2022-44)
items.summary: Approved a free 15-minute parking space in front of Ronnie's Place at 433 Salem Street.

items.title: Slow Children Signs - Stearns Avenue (Item 2022-45)
items.summary: Referred a request to replace and add warning signs on Stearns Avenue to the Highway Division.

items.title: No Parking Request - Greenleaf Avenue and Brookings Street (Item 2022-46)
items.summary: Approved a no-parking corner restriction at Greenleaf Avenue and Brookings Street, subject to distance advisement from the Fire Department.

items.title: Permit Parking Variance - 5 Sherborn Court (Item 2022-47)
items.summary: Approved a permit parking variance allowing a resident of 5 Sherborn Court to park on Bow Street.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign - 105 Brookings Street (Item 2022-48)
items.summary: Approved a request for a handicap parking sign at 105 Brookings Street.

items.title: Speed Table Request - Grove Street (Item 2022-50)
items.summary: Referred a request for a speed table between 238 and 260 Grove Street to the Engineering Department for further study.

items.title: Traffic Calming Request - Century Street Extension (Item 2022-51)
items.summary: Referred a traffic speed and speed table request on Century Street Extension to legal counsel to clarify the city's jurisdiction over a private way.

items.title: No Parking Request - Almond Street and Almond Court (Item 2022-52)
items.summary: Approved a no-parking corner restriction for both corners at Almond Street and Almond Court.

items.title: Handicap Parking Sign - 79 Dexter Street (Item 2022-53)
items.summary: Tabled a request for a handicap parking sign at 79 Dexter Street pending updated vehicle registration documentation.
